Package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client

package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client
The main public API for the PBCS/EPM Cloud Planning REST API: PbcsPlanningClient for the connection, PbcsApplication for an application, PbcsPlanType for a cube, and PbcsMember for outline members. Most application code should only need to depend on the interfaces in this package, not on any implementation classes in com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl.
Author:
Jason Jones
